Implement nf-visual: vi-inspired modal for nameforma mutations
focusStack.summary: Vi-inspired modal interface for browsing and mutating nameforma entities. Navigation: j/k moves cursor up/down through entity list, zo/zc zooms detail level in/out, / searches forward, ? searches backward. Each line represents a uuid64-identified entity. Mutations: edit, delete, create, link commands (keybindings TBD).

focusStack.name: Improve FuzzyId support
focusStack.summary: Implement INamespaced for World and Task. Architecture: Replace FormaList with FuzzyNamespace entirely as single unified system. (1) Extend FuzzyNamespace: add patchForma(), event bus support, mutation methods. (2) World implements INamespaced: namespace(bus) returns FuzzyNamespace of all top-level entities. (3) Task implements INamespaced: namespace(bus) returns combined FuzzyNamespace of actions + references (no more disjoint namespaces). (4) Update clients: CLI, tests to use namespace(bus). Key files: src/fuzzy-namespace.ts, src/world.ts, src/task.ts, src/forma-list.ts (to replace), src/cli/cli-task.ts (to update).

focusStack.name: Introduce IRegistry to unify IEntity, INamespaced, and IPatchable
focusStack.summary: Existing structure: IEntity (entity.ts) requires patch(); INamespaced (fuzzy-namespace.ts) requires namespace(); patch() methods scattered on Forma. Goal: Create IRegistry interface to unify these contracts and eliminate scattered patch implementations.
